item.title: New 19-month low: Hong Kong stocks plunge as AI sell-off spreads to Asia
item.description: Hong Kong stocks slid to their lowest level in 19 months on Monday, with technology shares hit the hardest, as a rout in US artificial intelligence stocks continued to spill over into Asia. The Hang Seng Tech Index, which tracks the city’s largest technology companies, fell as much as 3 per cent to below 3,400 points, taking its loss for the year to more than a third. It closed the morning trading session down 1.09 per cent. The benchmark Hang Seng Index declined as much as 1.8 per cent,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
